cells.name: x402 v2 exact / USDC / Base + Ethereum
MPP mpp.settlement/1 evidence profile
cells.why: Evidence profile exists. Production HTTP ingest remains POST /settlements (x402 v2 exact).
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Public post-settlement MPP spec + golden settlement vectors + HTTP ingest adapter + capabilities entry in the same PR.

cells.name: AP2 authorization evidence
cells.why: A mandate is authorization, not settlement.
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Bind a later CanonicalSettlement to the mandate. Do not fiscalize the mandate alone.

cells.name: evm-transfer adapter
cells.why: Library-level ERC-20 evidence. HTTP ingest is not public.
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Public HTTP ingest, confirmation policy, and golden vectors.

cells.name: Intra-EU B2C electronic services (OSS destination standard rate)
cells.why: Attested EU seller + attested EU consumer + electronic supply. Standard rate of destination member state. IP is not sole proof.

cells.name: Intra-EU B2B reverse charge (Art. 196) when VIES accepts the VAT ID
cells.why: VIES-accepted taxable person in another member state → AE / 0%. Failed or pending VIES is not reverse charge.

cells.name: Non-EU seller → attested EU customer electronic services (Art. 58 / Art. 196)
cells.why: Non-Union OSS destination standard rate, or Art. 196 reverse charge when VIES accepts.

cells.name: EU seller → attested non-EU customer electronic services
cells.why: Live POST /v1/capabilities/check returns MANUAL_REVIEW with reason export_vat_not_implemented. Art. 44/59 out-of-scope is not production until that live status is SUPPORTED. Not Art. 146 goods export, not IOSS, not a guessed VAT percentage.
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Same-release API deploy: live capabilities.check SUPPORTED for attested EU seller + non-EU buyer + electronic supply, then flip this cell to DETERMINED_PRODUCTION.

cells.name: EU goods / distance selling / IOSS
cells.why: No goods/IOSS engine. Electronic-services ruleset must not invent a goods rate.
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Dated IOSS/goods ruleset, golden vectors, and an explicit engine. Supply.kind of goods is not enough.

cells.name: EU reduced / super-reduced rates for electronic services
cells.why: Reduced/super-reduced bands are documented on the 2026.09 snapshot. TBE/SaaS/API use the standard rate. No verified supply-to-band mapping (e.g. e-publications).
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Per-member-state verified mapping of supply type → reduced band, sourced and tested. Until then, do not apply a reduced rate to TBE.

cells.name: UK VAT GB digital
cells.why: Experimental native engine. Not production-verified. Receipt v1 is not issued.
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Qualified tax review, GBP FX production path, UK invoice fields, golden vectors, public matrix update. Do not reuse receipt v1.

cells.name: US sales tax
cells.why: Provider boundary. No native US rate table. Nexus is never inferred from a single transaction.
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Verified provider (TaxJar/Avalara/Vertex/Sovos-class) or official dated rate dataset + nexus attestation + destination + taxability + marketplace-facilitator flag.

cells.name: Canada GST/HST/PST/QST
cells.why: Experimental native digital engines exist and are not production-verified. MB RST / SK PST remain MANUAL_REVIEW. No collapsed national VAT.
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Qualified tax review, attested consumer province, seller registration numbers per regime, CAD FX production path. Do not reuse receipt v1.

cells.name: Rest-of-world jurisdiction registry
cells.why: A registry row is not a tax engine. Unknown rates fail closed.
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Per-country dated ruleset, required facts list, golden vectors, public matrix update.

cells.name: fiscal402.receipt/1.0.0 + UBL 2.1 invoice
cells.why: Production for the EU VAT path. Hash is SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 bytes. VIES in the public receipt is status + vat_id_hash, not the raw VAT ID.

cells.name: UBL 2.1 CreditNote (UNCL 381)
cells.why: Factory exists (generateUbl21CreditNote). Production issuance still emits invoices. Corrections remain append-only events.
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Wire credit-note emission to the correction ledger with golden hash vectors, without changing receipt v1 invoice bytes.

cells.name: PEPPOL BIS Billing 3.0 mapping
cells.why: CustomizationID mapping helper only. Fiscal402 does not operate a PEPPOL access point and does not transmit documents.
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Implemented access point, SMP registration, and transport tests. Mapping identifiers is not network access.

cells.name: fiscal402.receipt/2.0.0
cells.why: Experimental multi-jurisdiction envelope. Production EU issuance remains v1.
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Frozen v2 schema, independent JWKS verify, golden vectors, no silent v1 reuse.

cells.name: Named ERP adapters
cells.why: Generic JSON/CSV journal exists. Exact/Xero/QuickBooks/NetSuite/SAP adapters do not.
cells.what_evidence_would_unblock_it: Optional exporters from the journal. Adapters post documents; they do not file returns.

exceptions.failed_or_pending_vies: PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW — reverse charge is not applied
